As always, if you haven’t already, please take a few seconds to leave a review on Steam. It really helps us a lot with the game’s development.

notes.title: #Episode 4.1 - Progress Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone on this peaceful Sunday!

I wanted to share some updates on our progress and what’s going on with us. So, as usual, let’s start with a quick overview:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/61f644be0946e4ec3dc0f9b7b96eba20b62ad6cb.png[/img]

As you can see, the scripts are now fully ready! That means the text part of Episode 4.1 is complete—we know exactly which scenes we’ll add, what content will be included, and all the extra details. We’re also past the halfway mark for the graphics—so far, we’ve created over four major scenes and a few additional elements. We’re slowly adding them to the game and testing everything to make sure it works. Soon, we’ll also start translating the scenes into all available game languages.

Progress is a bit slower than usual, but that’s because we’re working on multiple scenes at once, including some future ones. I won’t spoil anything now, but I promise you’ll love the surprise! On top of that, we’re still in the process of onboarding new artists, which hasn’t been going as smoothly as we hoped. Initially, we had four potential new artists, but one dropped out, and another didn’t meet our quality standards. That leaves us with two, and while we’re still trying to establish a long-term collaboration, we’ve run into quite a few challenges. Instead of speeding things up, it’s actually slowing us down, but I believe that in the long run, this investment will pay off.

Because of these setbacks, I can’t give you a specific release date for Episode 4.1 just yet. Some scenes are being handled by new artists, and I can’t be sure they’ll be finished on time or meet our quality expectations. If we need to redo or adjust them, it’ll take extra time. I value my word more than anything, so I’ll only announce a firm release date closer to March when I have more clarity.

But don’t worry! We’re taking a small step back now so we can jump forward and release content much faster in the future. My goal for 2025 remains the same—I’m aiming to release 12,000 new renders and tons of animations. We’ve already created over 1,500 this year, so once we get back on track, I hope to hit that target by October!

But enough talk—let’s get back to work! Here are a few renders for you to check out. 
Oh, and don't forget to leave a review, if you still did not -[b] let's get 1100 reviews till end of the month! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649970/Steps_of_Debauchery/

Have a great Sunday folks!

notes.title: Starting the Year Strong: Big Plans for Steps of Debauchery in 2025!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We’re kicking off the year with a bang! Everything is back on track as I'm already fully recovered. I have big plans for this year, mostly focused on Steps of Debauchery. My goal is to make significant progress with the story by the end of the year so that we can move closer to its conclusion in 2026. I’m not sure how many updates will come out this year, but I’m aiming to create around 12,000 renders and a lot of animations in 2025.

On top of the main storyline, we’ve also got some additional content planned for SoD. I can’t share the details just yet, but you can expect something big!

I didn’t mention this earlier, but during the work on update 4.0 last year, we created three big extra scenes featuring the red-haired Riley. We’ll be adding these scenes one by one to future updates since they’re very spicy! Even though we just got back from vacation, most of the scripts for episode 4.1 are already done, and we’ve started working on new renders.

You might have also seen some news about recruitment - we’re actively looking for new artists to speed up the development of updates and to make bigger scenes possible. It’s not easy because we focus on quality over quantity, and finding experienced artists is really tough. But I’m doing my best to deliver the best product for you, no matter the cost.

So, what can you expect in the next update?

[list]
[*] A new scene with Riley and Jirina
[*] A bit of rivalry (or maybe teamwork) between Riley and Madison as Dean’s assistants
[*] A meeting with Richard
[*] Solving Wesley’s problems
[*] Progress in the marriage storyline
[/list]
And a few other surprises - but I can’t spoil everything! We’re back at full speed now, and I’ll share the first progress update with you in about two weeks.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649970/Steps_of_Debauchery/]In the meantime, if you haven’t left a review yet, I’d really appreciate it! Your feedback means a lot to me and helps increase the game’s visibility, which also supports hiring new artists.[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649970/Steps_of_Debauchery/

Thanks, and talk to you soon!

notes.title: Episode 4.0 - Change Log
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Just a few days left until the release of [b]Episode 4.0[/b], so it’s time to share the changelog – here’s what’s new and what you can expect.

It’s been 2 months since our last update, and during that time, we’ve created:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/74c7fa96e095fd5826523bbe5104874b34aedffe.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Nearly [b]2,500 new renders[/b]
[*] A ton of new animations
[/list]

Not to brag, but getting this much done in just over two months (since Episode 3.2 update on October 7th) is a fantastic achievement in my opinion. This was only possible thanks to your support, which allowed me to take unpaid leave from my firefighting job. Starting in January, things will go back to normal, but I’ll keep working hard to bring you as much content as possible, as quickly as I can.

Before we move on, I want to address one thing. Someone suggested that going back to work will slow down the game’s development, making it impossible to deliver the full game by 2026. Here’s the truth: my unpaid leave was an extra boost that sped up development. This wasn’t part of the original plan because I didn’t expect such incredible financial support. So, while January will mean a return to the regular pace, we’re still on track – we’re not slowing down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/8913cf9b374117454c790679f5024d76cc2f19c2.png[/img]

Now, about the update itself:

[list]
[*] It includes more animations than the last few updates combined, and they’re quite complex. These aren’t 1-second loops – every animation is made of 200-300 frames, lasting 6-10 seconds, with sounds recorded by real people.
[*] This update is over twice the size of the previous one. However, it’s not twice as long – it’s more content-rich, giving you more choices and options. It will also tie together many of your earlier decisions.
[/list]
[b]
What else is new?[/b]
 
[list]
[*] New achievements
[*] Lots of custom wallpapers created for our supporters
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/16e984af14cb2c66ec5b19f680fafea090e53a76.png[/img]

We’ve also added and improved tons of smaller things that I might have forgotten to mention (probably because they weren’t as big). If I remember anything, I’ll let you know – or maybe I’ll keep it as a surprise. 😏

We’ve translated the game into Polish, which will be available later on (around December 23-24), because we have to polish (hehe) the language a little. Along the new language we will release another cool thing: [b]Steam trading cards[/b], including badges, backgrounds, and emoticons for your profiles. These will launch alongside the Polish translation – fingers crossed we can get it done on time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/617d081036520635f63458d9e7bed7d82949e6ae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/9f2104911b35dd6e6da49c647b88509d2d13c28c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/0bc060aeb43d28de612585ba78f3bf205e8b9c1e.png[/img]

For now, I’m back to fixing the last bugs and making sure the update is ready for you. If you still haven’t left a review on Steam, do it now!

notes.title: Episode 4.0 - progress update & release date
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's time to share our latest progress update. As usual, you’ll find the chart below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/4c1efddfa0fb5cf9451335f3db702aa7d356d863.png[/img]

As you can see, the scripts and written content for the game are now fully completed. For some time now, our writers have been working on future scenes to avoid unnecessary delays later on. The most time-consuming tasks remain rendering and animation, due to our current production capacity. We're actively looking for more skilled artists, but finding experienced professionals is a challenge. Lowering our quality standards is the last thing we want to do. We're also integrating the source code and testing everything so that only minor fixes will remain at the end.

We’re nearing the milestone of 2,000 renders, and we estimate the final count will be around 2,500–3,000. That’s a huge number, especially given how little time has passed since the last update. On top of that, this update will feature A LOT of animations. Besides the main scenes, we’re also planning to add a few extra features if time and resources allow.

Additionally, we’ve started working on translations for all the content currently in the game, so everything will be available simultaneously. On a side note, we’re happy to announce that a Polish translation will likely (95% certainty) be included as well, since many of you have requested it. We hope you’ll enjoy it!

Now for the most exciting news—the one you’ve probably been waiting for: Update 4.0 will launch on Monday, December 16th. Supporters in the +Lovers tier on Patreon will get early access on Friday, December 13th. That means we’re less than 30 days away from your holiday gift!

That’s all for now. We’re leaving you with a few renders and wish you a peaceful week ahead. 😊

notes.title: Episode 4.0 current progress and previews
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First, a few words about the recent feedback I got from you. Besides the recurring comments like:

- we waited too long for such a short update,
- not enough sex scenes,

...the overall feedback of the last update was mostly positive, which makes me really happy. Of course, there are always things that need improvement, and we'll keep fixing them as we go.

To answer a few other questions: this will be a bit bigger update than usual, definitely more comprehensive, and it will address some of the questions you've had. As we originally planned, we aim to release the full game in the first half of 2026, and that hasn't changed. We'll probably wrap up Riley's story by episode 7 or 8, depending on how many extra scenes and content we decide to add.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/2c3b900501f30996da8e39cfeda52876bcb7612b.png[/img]

Time for an update on our progress two weeks after the last release. I’m happy to say things are going really well. Thanks to taking unpaid leave, I can fully focus on the project, and because of that, we’re moving faster and more efficiently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/6a63915d663138a7cc78ae6f63b762cce68a1896.png[/img]

As you can see, we’ve nearly finished writing the scripts for the latest episode. I think we’ll have that part wrapped up in the next 7 days. We've also completed 30% of the required renders and animations, which is a number I’m pretty happy with for just two weeks of work.

As for coding and testing, we’ve fixed all the reported bugs in Episode 3.2, so everything should run smoothly now.

As you can see, everything is going according to plan. We're still confident that we’ll be able to release the next episode before the Xmass. It’s going to be one of the bigger ones, but not too long - it will contain plenty of branching paths and answers to some of your burning questions. I won’t spoil anything else—you’ll have to wait until December!

As always, I’m leaving you with a few renders, and I wish you all a great week!

notes.title: Episode 3.1 - Update Summary, Game Development and Notes
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hey everyone![/h1][/b]

I have a lot to share with you today, but let's start with a summary of the latest update and some of my notes. I've already shared these on Discord, but I'll summarize them here too.

The days after releasing a new update are always the toughest for me mentally. I spend them combing through every forum reading players feedback. This includes everything from trolls and long-time critics to supportive fans. I’m also on the lookout for bugs reported by players so we can fix them promptly. 

[h2]Bugs and Issues[/h2] 
We've fixed all the reported bugs. One critical bug related to the iSpy app was preventing further progress in some cases. There were also minor issues with minigames, Discord on Mac, and a missing scene in the replay gallery. These have all been fixed. We've also made the dance minigame a bit easier and we’re ready to fix any new bugs immediately.

[h2]Feedback on Update Length[/h2] 
I've addressed this many times, but here’s my previous information about the developing job (I wrote it some time ago, so that's copy-paste):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/b3cddb803b21ad4f3b28adf359e9870d664d1b34.jpg[/img]
...my job as a firefighter sometimes allows me extra time off, which I dedicate to game development. Over the past three months (aside from my vacation), I’ve been working 12-16 hours daily to create what we’ve released. Despite this, some still find the update “short.” I might need to slow down and give myself more mental freedom because no matter how hard I work, people will always complain about the update being too short. (edit. we are actively looking for additional Daz3D artists, but we rather want to improve the quality of the renders, so finding the right person(s) is very hard and we have not succeeded so far).

[h2]Content and Story Feedback[/h2] 
I agree that we could have added more sexual content to the yacht scene, but I didn't think it was appropriate and really needed. We don't want to add empty sex scenes just for the sake of it. This update was not shallow in my opinion, as it containted three other sex scenes. I'm sure we'll soon get to the point where everyone will see what they're waiting for, but scenes in which sexual acts don't occur also affect the main character's mental attitude. You may disagree with this, but it does not change my approach to the storyline we are creating.

It’s important to remember that an Adult Visual Novel combines both - "Adult" content, but also "Novel" aspect. If someone is here only for the adult content and ignores the novel aspect, they might be disappointed—that’s not our aim (yes, I'm aware we are creating porn game :wink:)

Regarding complaints about the D&D, Elijah or any other plotlines: it's impossible to please everyone. Some enjoy these storylines, others don’t. Making them optional would undermine the main narrative. Every plot point, including D&D, has an impact on the main character, if not now, then in future updates. We don't add random storylines; everything has a purpose. We also can't feature every character in every update. Episode 2.2 focused on Elijah and Richard; 3.0 focused on other things; episode 3.1 will be about something else. We’re doing our best to release content quickly and on time. If you found this update small, you might want to wait for 4.0 and skip previous two small updates till then.

Lastly, regarding the bar minigame: it’s optional and doesn’t affect the main story, but we already made it easier for everyone. It will have its development in episode 3.1 but will remain non-essential to the main plot.

That would be it. I take every feedback to heart, we have our idea for the game, but we also take your opinion into consideration. However, we will not add a sex scene with Riley, just because we feel such pressure on our backs. I am always available to you and I write back to every message, however, if you need help with the game or you have encountered an error - share it on discord so that it is easier to solve them. If you would like to add something, feel free to comment and share your thoughts.

[h1]That will be it about Episode 3.0, so let's move to development of Episode 3.1 and some notes![/h1]

[b]Progress on Episode 3.1 is going smoothly.[/b] As you can see in the image below, our scripts and writing are almost done. We've also completed about 40% of the graphics and renders, and started adding new scenes and content directly to the game. We're planning to add six main scenes, one extra scene, and more activities related to the park, school, and the bar minigame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/fd5920b99469e400dc9e55816029483f59e96015.png[/img]

[b]Episode 3.1 will be a small update.[/b] We're sticking to our plan of releasing two small updates (x.1 and x.2) followed by a bigger one (0.x). [b]If you don't like small updates, please wait for the next one or even Episode 4.0.[/b] Respect our work and refrain from comments like "too short." We're doing our best to release updates regularly and spend all our free time creating the game. The new update will be out in mid-August.

(Who would I be if I didn't share a few new renders?)

Take care and see you soon!

notes.title: Compress game assets and fix a crash in German language
notes.content:
* A hard crash that happened while playing in German language has been fixed.
* Some game assets have been compressed so that the game takes less space.

notes.title: Quick crash fixes
notes.content:
* Fix a crash where the game will refuse to start if the save name contains a single `[`.
* Fix a rare (but persistent) crash related to Discord which prevented the game from starting.

notes.title: Changes to Pole minigame to make it easier
notes.content:
* Now the pole minigame only requires using the arrow keys and the duration to click has been increased slightly.
* Now the phone can be exited when clicked outside when hone is on main screen.
* A rare crash while replaying one university scene has been fixed.
* In rare cases, school test will only have four questions. That's been fixed.

notes.title: Quick Bug fixes
notes.content:
* Don't allow people to screenshot even while EXP counting during the pole dance minigame.
* Add the school replay scene in gallery.
* Don't allow people to exit exhibition event early. For players who have already played this event before, please play this again and this time it should handle things well and you will be able to advance in the story.
You can start by going to the laptop, clicking on iSpy and then reveal.

Might be fixed (need more testing)
* Startup crash on Mac. (If you are still experiencing this crash on the latest update, either delete the .DISCORD_ON file or rename it).

notes.title: Minor update to Episode 2.2
notes.content:
* Fixed a hard crash when playing in the German language.
* Fixed a hard crash when opening the Boutique shop in the Portuguese Language.
* Fixed two typos.
* Updated base engine (Ren'Py).
